title: Broncos have signed Head Coach Sean Payton to a new five-year contract

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos have signed Head Coach Sean Payton to a new five-year contract
sources.description: According to ESPN’s NFL league insider Adam Schefter, the Denver Broncos and head coach Sean Payton have reached an agreement on a new five-year contract. More on this developing story soon.
